entries.en: Funnily enough, we chose the same birthday present without speaking to each other.
entries.zh: 说来也巧，我们没互相通气，却选了同样的生日礼物。

entries.en: We walked in single file along the narrow path above the beach.
entries.zh: 我们沿着海滩上方的狭窄小路排成一列行走。

entries.en: Fold the second sheet in the same way, with the coloured side facing out.
entries.zh: 把第二张纸也以同样的方式折好，让有颜色的一面朝外。

entries.meaningZh: 既然这样；在这种情况下
entries.en: The last train has gone; in the circumstances, staying here seems sensible.
entries.zh: 末班车已经走了；既然这样，留在这里似乎比较明智。

entries.en: She moved the glass vase out of harm's way before the children started playing.
entries.zh: 孩子们开始玩耍之前，她把玻璃花瓶移到了安全的地方。

entries.en: The steep final climb tested our patience to the utmost.
entries.zh: 最后那段陡峭的攀登极大地考验了我们的耐心。

entries.en: Half the time, I forget why I opened the fridge in the first place.
entries.zh: 我常常忘了自己当初为什么打开冰箱。

entries.en: Asked whether she could attend on Friday, she replied in the affirmative.
entries.zh: 被问到周五能否出席时，她作了肯定的回答。

entries.en: Two volunteers waited on standby in case we needed help carrying the chairs.
entries.zh: 两名志愿者随时待命，以备我们搬椅子时需要帮忙。

entries.en: I won't share your private messages under any circumstances.
entries.zh: 我在任何情况下都不会分享你的私人消息。

entries.en: She found the missing button and sewed it back on in a trice.
entries.zh: 她找到那颗不见了的纽扣，转眼就把它缝了回去。

entries.en: In the last resort, we could postpone the picnic until next weekend.
entries.zh: 实在没有别的办法，我们可以把野餐推迟到下个周末。

entries.en: The smaller flat has better storage; in this respect, it suits us better.
entries.zh: 那套较小的公寓储物空间更好；在这方面，它更适合我们。

entries.en: We need clearer instructions, and your comments would help us in this regard.
entries.zh: 我们需要更清楚的说明，而你的意见会在这一点上帮到我们。

entries.meaningZh: 用隐蔽或不正当的方法；走后门
entries.en: The committee feared that the rule would let wealthy applicants enter the college by the back door.
entries.zh: 委员会担心，这条规定会让有钱的申请者走后门进入这所学院。

entries.en: The delay didn't bother me in the slightest; I had a book with me.
entries.zh: 那点耽搁丝毫没让我烦恼；我随身带着一本书。

entries.en: We stopped for lunch in the middle of nowhere, beside an empty railway station.
entries.zh: 我们在一个偏僻的地方停下来吃午饭，旁边是一座空荡荡的火车站。

entries.en: It's late; I'll call the repair shop in the morning.
entries.zh: 已经很晚了；我明天早晨再给维修店打电话。

entries.en: The grand title impressed her not a whit; she wanted to see the actual work.
entries.zh: 那个响亮的头衔丝毫没有打动她；她想看实际做出的工作。

entries.en: For one weekend, we lived in the lap of luxury in a hotel with its own cinema.
entries.zh: 有一个周末，我们住在一家自带电影院的酒店里，享受了一番奢华生活。

entries.en: As the deadline approached, she became ever more careful about backing up her work.
entries.zh: 随着截止日期临近，她在备份自己的工作时变得越来越谨慎。

entries.en: The new timetable helped in some measure, though the buses were still crowded.
entries.zh: 新时刻表在一定程度上起了作用，不过公交车仍然拥挤。

entries.en: I was none too pleased to find my wet coat on the bed.
entries.zh: 发现自己的湿外套在床上，我不太高兴。

entries.meaningZh: 毫无准备地；不假思索地
entries.en: I can't remember the exact address off hand, but I can check my notebook.
entries.zh: 我一下子想不起确切地址，不过可以查查我的笔记本。

entries.en: The path was flooded; on this account, we took the longer route through the village.
entries.zh: 小路被水淹了；因此，我们走了穿过村庄的那条较远的路。

entries.en: When asked whether the missing keys were hers, she answered in the negative.
entries.zh: 被问到那串丢失的钥匙是不是她的时，她作了否定的回答。

entries.en: The bank took the damaged notes out of circulation after sorting the day's cash.
entries.zh: 银行整理当天的现金后，让破损钞票退出了流通。

entries.en: Local residents turned out in strength to help clear the fallen branches.
entries.zh: 当地居民纷纷前来，帮忙清理掉落的树枝。

entries.meaningZh: 为了好玩；为了寻求刺激
entries.en: We entered the costume contest for kicks and somehow won a prize.
entries.zh: 我们只是为了好玩参加了化装比赛，没想到还得了奖。

entries.en: The sketch is useful as far as it goes, but it leaves out the stairs.
entries.zh: 这张草图就现有内容而言是有用的，不过它漏掉了楼梯。

entries.en: She backed her friend's proposal up to the hilt during the meeting.
entries.zh: 会上，她全力支持朋友的提议。

entries.en: On an average, I spend about twenty minutes walking to the station.
entries.zh: 平均而言，我步行到车站大约花二十分钟。

entries.en: The donation covered the repair bill twice over, leaving enough for new chairs.
entries.zh: 那笔捐款足以支付两倍的维修费用，付完账单后还有钱买新椅子。

entries.en: The first guests arrived as early as six, before the tables were ready.
entries.zh: 最早一批客人六点就到了，那时桌子还没有布置好。

entries.en: A loose window banged shut in the dead of night and woke everyone upstairs.
entries.zh: 深更半夜，一扇松动的窗户砰地关上，把楼上的人都吵醒了。

entries.en: We ate our sandwiches in the shade while the others sat in the sun.
entries.zh: 我们在阴凉处吃三明治，其他人则坐在太阳下。

entries.en: We travelled in company for most of the journey, then caught different trains home.
entries.zh: 大部分路程我们都结伴同行，后来分别乘不同的火车回家。

entries.en: They parted on friendly terms after deciding to end their business partnership.
entries.zh: 他们决定结束商业合作后，友好地分道扬镳。

entries.en: In a tight corner, we accepted the only offer that would keep the shop open.
entries.zh: 身处困境时，我们接受了唯一能让店铺继续营业的提议。

entries.en: He landed in hot water after borrowing the office projector without asking.
entries.zh: 他没打招呼就借走了办公室的投影仪，结果惹上了麻烦。

entries.en: I agree with your plan to a certain degree, but the cost still worries me.
entries.zh: 我在一定程度上赞同你的计划，不过费用仍让我担心。

entries.en: Without more ado, she picked up the microphone and began the first song.
entries.zh: 她不再耽搁，拿起麦克风唱起了第一首歌。

entries.en: The manager made it clear that nobody could bully the new staff with impunity.
entries.zh: 经理明确表示，谁都不能欺负新员工而不受惩罚。

entries.en: The new bridge halved our travel time and removed two awkward transfers at one fell swoop.
entries.zh: 新桥一举把我们的出行时间缩短了一半，还省去了两次麻烦的换乘。
